material_findings.finding: tools/trigger2_semantic_hyperposition_gate_v2.py imports trigger2_semantic_hyperposition_reference_labelers_v1.py, while that path is absent on current main. The gate also predates later dual-v2 labeler convergence work.

material_findings.finding: Two v2 reference-labeler semantics now coexist: event-vs-ancestry handling and payload/independence/full-state validation. They overlap and must not become competing semantic authorities.
material_findings.action: Fuse into one explicitly versioned successor that derives relations/test separation from formal task-world semantics and preserves event replay, correlation ancestry, dependence identity, branch birth/merge/projection and anti-collapse semantics.

material_findings.finding: A formal synthetic task-world relation-derivation chain landed during this cycle and removes free-text/model-generated label derivation for branch relation/test outcome inputs.
material_findings.action: Fuse this derivation primitive into the single converged reference-labeler/gate path; do not grant training credit from source presence alone.

material_findings.finding: The newly landed Hyperposition-native seed generator imports semantic_hyperposition_gate_v2 and therefore inherits its exact-current missing-labeler dependency. Its candidate examples remain donor scenarios, not executable admitted data, until dependency convergence is repaired.
material_findings.action: Regenerate after the converged labeler/gate successor and rerun family/nuisance/lexical-null gates.

material_findings.action: Require token-injection, lexical-null and non-reasoning controls before semantic J-Space feature promotion.

material_findings.action: Do not change JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 from literature alone; preregister a same-Qwen static-vs-contextual gain test with layer/context holdouts and full causal controls.
